Why did dinosaurs dominate after the Triassic/Jurassic extinction?
Crocodile-line archosaurs wiped out; bird-line (dinosaurs, pterosaurs) survived

Why did angiosperms radiate so fast?
Double fertilization, fruit dispersal, rapid generation time, pollinator coevolution
What evidence proves a K-Pg impact?
Iridium anomaly, shocked quartz, tektites, Chicxulub crater, tsunami deposits
What survived the K-Pg and why?
Small, dietary-flexible, dormancy/seed strategies: birds, mammals, crocodiles, turtles
What is the Mesozoic Marine Revolution?
Predation escalation (durophagy, drilling) from Triassic → Cretaceous → prey shell thickening
